study_identification_part.si_4_title: Heterogeneity of morphometric similarity networks in health and schizophrenia

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Bayesian linear regression with likelihood warping (B-spline) for normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Bayesian linear regression (BLR) with likelihood warping using a B-spline (spline order = 3, number of knots = 5) was used to predict morphometric similarity from a vector of covariates (age, sex, Euler number, and scanner)
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Normative modeling of morphometric similarity

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Regional morphometric similarity per DKT cortical region derived from cortical thickness, surface area, cortical volume, mean curvature, and Gaussian curvature.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Using regional measurements of cortical thickness, surface area, cortical volume, mean curvature, and Gaussian curvature, we calculated regional morphometric similarity

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Covariates included age, sex, Euler number (image quality), and scanner.
